results.title: Fed interest rate decision April 2026: Fed holds rates steady amid dissent
results.summary: FOMC voted 8-4 to hold benchmark funds rate at 3.5%-3.75%. Powell's likely final meeting as chair. Three dissented to remove reference to future cut; one (Trump appointee Miran) dissented for immediate cut. Last 4-dissent vote was October 1992. Markets pricing no changes rest of 2026 and well into 2027.

results.title: US Fed holds rates steady, Powell to remain on its board
results.summary: Powell to stay on Fed board after stepping down as chair. Committee noted elevated inflation partly from global energy prices. Middle East contributing to high uncertainty.
